title: dekha kiye yateem jo qanjar tamaam raat
body:
dekha kiye yateem jo qanjar tamaam raat
aankho me mout phirti thi lekar tamaam haai
Haaris ne ek sutoon se baandha tha raat ko
bebas khade hue the ye dilbar tamaam raat
<<DIVIDER>>
ek tegh rakh di shamma jalaa kar layeen ne
hota tha inki aankho me mehshar tamaam raat
jhapki na ankh bacho ki ek pal ke waaste
sota raha sukoo'n se sitamgar tamaam raat
<<DIVIDER>>
do chaand the jo mout ki manzil me aa gaye
ghar tha layee'n ka unse munawwar tamaam raat
bechain hoke qaanae haaris ke ird gird
phirti thi roohe muslime bepar tamaam raat
